description.zh: 模型所在Collection，支持填写多个，用英文逗号分割
description.en: The collections to which the model belongs. You can specify multiple collections. Separate them with commas (,).

description.zh: 条件。
description.en: The conditions.

description.zh: 参数名。如：ParameterSize。
description.en: The parameter name. Example: ParameterSize.

description.zh: 操作符。如：LessThan。
description.en: The operator. Example: LessThan.
The value. Example: 3000.

description.zh: 配置领域来过滤该领域内的模型列表。例如：nlp（自然语言处理）、cv（计算机视觉）等。
description.en: The domain. This parameter is used to filter the model list by domain. Examples: nlp (natural language processing) and cv (computer vision).

description.zh: 标签串。用于列表过滤，标签中key或value中，有指定字符串的，都会被过滤出来。
description.en: The label string. This parameter is used to filter the list. Models are returned if their label keys or values contain the specified string.

description.zh: 配置模型名称，用来过滤获取的模型列表。
description.en: The model name. This parameter is used to filter the model list.

description.zh: 模型类型
description.en: The model type.

description.zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序。默认ASC。
- ASC：升序。
- DESC：降序。
description.en:
The order in which to sort the results of a paged query. The default value is ASC.

- ASC: ascending order.

- DESC: descending order.

description.zh: 配置模型源，来过滤属于该社区或组织的模型列表。例如ModelScope，HuggingFace等。
description.en: The model source. This parameter is used to filter the model list by community or organization. Examples: ModelScope and HuggingFace.

description.zh: 模型列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number of the model list. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的模型数量，默认为10。
description.en: The number of models to display on each page in a paged query. The default value is 10.

description.zh: 提供者。指定提供者，则只返回该提供者公开的模型。不填则返回用户自己的模型。
description.en: The provider. If you specify a provider, only the public models from that provider are returned. If you leave this parameter empty, your own models are returned.

description.zh:
配置查询条件。ModelName、Domain、Task、LabelKey、LabelValue相似匹配。
例如输入为nlp，则ModelName、Domain、Task、LabelKey、LabelValue中匹配的模型都会返回。
description.en: The query condition. This parameter performs a fuzzy match on ModelName, Domain, Task, LabelKey, and LabelValue. For example, if you enter nlp, models that match in any of these fields are returned.

description.zh: 分页查询时的排序字段。目前使用GmtCreateTime字段用于排序。
description.en: The field to use for sorting in a paged query. Currently, only the GmtCreateTime field is supported.

description.zh: 标签列表。
description.en: The list of tags.

description.zh: 标签的key。
description.en: The key of the tag.

description.zh: 标签的value。
description.en: The value of the tag.

description.zh: 配置任务来过滤属于该任务类型的模型列表。例如：text-classification（文本分类）等。
description.en: The task. This parameter is used to filter the model list by task type. Example: text-classification.

description.zh: 配置工作空间ID，返回列表中只获取该工作空间内的模型列表。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: The workspace ID. The returned list contains only the models in the specified workspace. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace list-models --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --order DESC --sort-by GmtCreateTime --workspace-id 32400 --model-name Sentiment_analysis --label key1 --provider pai --domain nlp --task text-classification --origin ModelScope --query nlp --model-type Endpoint --collections AI4D,QuickStart --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --conditions Operator=LessThan Column=ParameterSize Value=3000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/models --region cn-hangzhou --Order DESC --Origin ModelScope --Task 'text-classification' --ModelName Sentiment_analysis --PageSize 10 --Query nlp --SortBy GmtCreateTime --WorkspaceId 32400 --Label key1 --Conditions '[{"Operator":"LessThan","Column":"ParameterSize","Value":"3000"}]' --Provider pai --PageNumber 1 --ModelType Endpoint --Tag '[{"Value":"value1","Key":"key1"}]' --Domain nlp --Collections 'AI4D,QuickStart' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
